items.name: XpenseSplitter
items.tagline: Shared expense tracking for group trips — no server, no accounts, and trips that travel by link.

image.alt: The XpenseSplitter landing screen, headed "Split the trip. Settle up in seconds."

items.why: Splitting costs on a trip always ends the same way: a spreadsheet nobody keeps up to date, or an app that wants everyone to make an account before it will accept a number. I wanted one where the maths is provably right and the data never leaves the people on the trip. So there is no server, no database and no sign-up — a trip is a file you can hand over, or a link that carries it.
features: Chronological ledger — amount, category, who paid, and exactly who splits it.
Live per-person share preview as you toggle people in and out.
A read-only explorer to search, sort and group, so anyone can check themselves.
Settlement two ways: every pairwise debt, or the fewest transfers that clear it.
Many trips, autosaved locally, with a one-file-per-trip zip backup.
notes: Largest-remainder rounding, so a split always sums back to the total.
Merging is an identity problem first: people are matched across files before writing.
Duplicates match on amount, payer and the exact set of people sharing.
A share link carries the trip in its URL fragment, so nothing reaches a host.
A lineage id tells an arriving link which copy is newer, with no server to arbitrate.
